Ready to take your career global?
 Make your mark at one of the biggest names in payments. We’re looking for a Software Engineer I to join our ever-evolving Alternative Payment Methods delivery team and help us unleash the potential of every business.
 What You’ll Own
 You will collaborate with your cross-functional team to design, develop, operate and improve the products our customers enjoy using. You will work with the wider engineering department to bring solutions to challenges that require cross team collaboration. As a member of the team, you will also have a deep understanding of the product and industry you are building for.
 Main Duties And Responsibilities
Collaboratively develop the features and engineering capabilities for the products your team own. We aim to employ automation for everything.
Collaborate in all stages of development from requirement discussions with the Product Owner to the deployment of the feature in the cloud.
Join the on-call rota to support the highly available products developed by the squad.
Provide your team with the tools to enable data driven decision making.
Collaborate with your fellow engineers from other teams to make decisions around technologies, patterns and approaches to adopt.
 What You'll Bring
2-3 years of hands-on experience
Experience in Java, Spring
Experience working in a Continuous Delivery Environment
Knowledgeable on technology architectures and approaches such as Event Driven Design, Domain Driven Design, Event Sourcing & CQRS
Knowledgeable on delivering products/services in the cloud (AWS)
Knowledgeable on BDD / TDD practices
Knowledgeable on DevOps best practices, technologies, and tools (Ansible, Terraform)
Fluent in English (written and verbal)
 About The Team
 Our inclusive and global teams win together every day. We’re proud to have the best minds in the industry, who you can learn from as you grow your career. The people, the energy, the connections – it’s unmatched. Come and be part of an ever-evolving company and get dynamic opportunities that go beyond borders.
 What makes a Globalpayer?
 Globalpayers think like a client, act like an owner and win as one team. We’re curious and innovative – always finding better ways to deliver impact. We empower each other to make decisions, and it’s our passion that drives excellence in everything we set out to do.
Does this sound like you? Then you sound like a Globalpayer. Apply now to take your career global.
